t: In jewellers block insurance policy, the insured is required to inform the police ________________.

t:
Identify the true statement with regard to claim payable in a Personal Accident policy in case of Suicide.

I. Suicide is considered to be an accident for paying the claim under PA policy.
II. Suicide is considered to be an offence under the Indian Penal Code and the insured is not allowed to benefit from his own criminal act.
III. When the circumstances are such that the evidence is equally consistent with either suicide or accident, then the presumption of law against suicide applies and accident will be presumed.
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC78 question bank).

t: In cattle insurance, what is the normal premium rate for non-scheme animals?

t:
Personal accident policies are contracts which are not strictly subject to the principle of indemnity. This is because:-

I. An insured is not allowed to make profit out of his insurance
II. Life is invaluable and no amount of money can compensate the death or disablement of a human being
III. If there are more than one policies available on the date of loss, each policy will pay the full benefits under the same
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC78 question bank).

In sports insurance, indemnity is available for:-

II. Loss of or damage to sporting accessories
III. Loss of or damage to sporting apparel

III. Fall from a tree
